messages.name: string
messages.digest: Output a string if different from the previous string.
messages.description: If the string has changed, then a 1 will be sent out the right outlet, and the string will be sent out of the left outlet. Otherwise, a 0 is sent out the right outlet only. In either case, the internal value of the previous string will update. Use the right inlet to update the value of the previous string without output.
